name: Fable Barbell
strategy: Cross-sectional sector-momentum long/short: long the top-5 non-AI momentum ETFs vs short the bottom-3 broken downtrends, correlation-deduped, with hard stop/take-profit discipline, re-ranked weekly.
novelty: R1/R2 both earned long market beta shaped as a barbell. R3's driver is the cross-sectional momentum spread itself: long strongest non-AI sectors against shorts in weakest broken trends, so P&L comes from relative trend continuation, not index direction or AI capex. No ballast sleeve; risk managed by stops instead of defensive assets.

positions.thesis: Top momentum rank: biotech breakout on M&A wave and rate-cut duration bid.
Airlines +16% 3m: travel strength plus fuel-cost relief.
Weakest rank in universe (-32% 6m): silver parabola deflating.
Junior gold miners -24% 6m, downtrend intact across lookbacks.
Uranium miners -22% 6m, distinct cluster, negative momentum every horizon.

backtest.notes: Big alpha in trending regimes and strong crash protection in 2022; momentum crashes hurt (2020 COVID). Live shorts are post-crash trades with squeeze risk bounded by 18% stops.

outlook: The tape is rotating from deflating metals/crypto parabolas into cyclical breadth; this book monetizes both legs, stops cap regime-flip damage.
